description: The Partner entity represents an organization or individual with whom your business collaborates, trades, or interacts. This comprehensive UI guidance covers all aspects of managing partner records, from browsing and searching to detailed viewing, editing, and status management. It serves as the central repository for all partner-related information, enabling efficient tracking of relationships, contacts, and interactions.

pages.name: PartnerComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for managing all partner organizations. Users can view a comprehensive list of partners, search for specific entities, apply filters to narrow down results, and perform various actions such as creating new partners, editing existing ones, or importing data in bulk. It provides an overview of all partner-related activities and allows for efficient management of the partner ecosystem.

buttons.label: New Partner | Edit Partner
buttons.description: This button opens a dialog to either create a new partner organization or edit the details of an existing one. It provides comprehensive form fields for managing all aspects of partner information, including organizational details, contacts, and business relationships.
when_to_use: When you need to create a new partner organization from scratch.
When you need to modify the details of an existing partner, such as updating their organizational information, contacts, or business relationships.

buttons.label: Import Partners
buttons.description: This button initiates the bulk import process for partner organizations. It opens a dialog where you can upload data from external sources like Google Sheets or CSV files, ideal for migrating large datasets or setting up initial partner records quickly.
when_to_use: When you need to add multiple partner organizations to the system simultaneously from an external file.
Ideal for initial data migration or when integrating data from other systems.

tabs.description: Shows a history of all recorded communications, meetings, and activities with the partner.

tabs.name: Data
tabs.label: title.data

search.placeholder: Search partners by name, type, or location...
search.description: This search bar allows you to quickly find specific partner organizations by typing keywords such as their name, type (e.g., 'Vendor', 'Client'), or geographical location. The list of partners will dynamically update as you type.
search.help_text: To find a partner, simply type any part of their name, type, or location into the search bar. The results will filter in real-time. For example, typing 'Acme' will show all partners with 'Acme' in their name.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble finding a partner, use the search bar at the top to search by name, type, or location. To add a new partner, click the 'New Partner' button. If you need to narrow down the list, look for filtering options (if available) to refine results by partner type, status, or organizational unit.
common_tasks: Finding a partner: Use the search bar at the top of the page to quickly locate partners by name, type, or location. You can also use advanced filters (if available) to refine your search.
Creating a new partner: Click the 'New Partner' button to open the creation form and enter the required details.
Editing an existing partner: Click on any partner row in the list to navigate to its detail page, then click the 'Edit' button there.
Filtering partners: Utilize the available filter options (if present) to narrow down the list of partners based on criteria like partner type, status, or organizational unit.
Exporting partner data: Click the 'Export' button to download the current list of partners into an Excel spreadsheet for external use or reporting.
Importing multiple partners: Use the 'Import Partners' button to upload a file (e.g., CSV) containing multiple partner records, allowing for bulk data entry.

pages.name: PartnerViewComponent
pages.description: This page provides a comprehensive view of a single partner organization, allowing users to inspect and manage all associated details. It includes sections for general information, contact details, historical interactions, and related data. Users can edit partner information, upload a logo, manage documents, and update the partner's status.

buttons.label: Edit Partner
buttons.description: This button opens a dialog or navigates to a form where you can modify all editable details of the current partner organization, including general information, contact details, and other attributes.
when_to_use: When any information about the partner needs to be updated or corrected.
When adding new organizational details or refining existing ones.

buttons.label: Approve
buttons.description: This button initiates the approval workflow for the partner. Clicking it will typically open a confirmation dialog, followed by an approval dialog, allowing authorized users to formally approve the partner's status.
when_to_use: When a partner's status requires formal approval and you have the necessary permissions.
To move a partner to an 'Approved' state within the system.

buttons.label: Activate
buttons.description: This button activates the partner, making them fully operational or visible within the system. It typically opens a confirmation dialog before proceeding with the activation.
when_to_use: When a partner needs to be moved from an inactive or pending state to an active status.
To enable full functionality and visibility for the partner within the system.

help_guidance.when_stuck: This page displays all the detailed information about the selected partner. If you need to make changes, click the 'Edit' button. Use the tabs (Details, Contacts, Interactions, Data) to navigate between different categories of information. To update the partner's logo, click on the existing logo or image area.
common_tasks: Editing partner information: Click the 'Edit Partner' button to open the form and modify any details about the partner.
Uploading a partner logo: Click on the designated logo or image area to upload a new visual representation for the partner.
Viewing partner contacts: Navigate to the 'Contacts' tab to see a list of all individuals associated with this partner organization.
Adding new interactions: Go to the 'Interactions' tab and look for an 'Add Interaction' button or similar control to log new communications or activities.
Managing partner documents: Scroll down to the 'Documents' section (if available) to upload new files or view existing ones related to the partner.
Updating partner address: Locate the 'Contact Information' section and directly edit the address fields to update the partner's physical location.
